name: THE HOTEL CLERK
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HIM: on the floor before the desk's left end (errata 91 C).
note: THE HOTEL CLERK, behind his desk with the register open before him. No document describes him; doc 27 gives his voice, and he is drawn as a fussy desk clerk of the period (errata 91 B): five poses on magenta against Thad (room-18 operation 3), cut at the desk top by tools/art/room18-clerk.py, the register a plane in front of him. BEHIND THE DESK: `y` is the cut row. Present in every act.
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for the clerk.

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest, reading the register · 1 breath (derived) · 2 writing · 3 looking up over his spectacles · 4 turning the register round (doc 27 option 4). A break every `breakEvery` seconds (errata 77). He looks up as he talks.
